applicability: any two-digit integer N in [10, 99]; when the two digits sum to less than 10 the simple split-add-drop form gives the answer directly, and when the digits sum to 10 or more the middle digit carries 1 into the left digit
carry_case: 78 × 11: 7 + 8 = 15, so the middle is 5 and 1 carries → (7+1)(5)(8) = 858

steps.instruction: Drop the sum in the middle
If the digits sum to 10 or more, carry

sampling.notes: Range [10,99] with two-digit presentation filter matches the declared applicability. Draw 20 was used as-is; the trick applies (digit sum 2 < 10, no carry) and the caveat step covers the carry branch on 78.
